exposure: PND related to the previous birth
inadequate communication with health care providers
outcome: fear and mistrust of healthcare professionals
cohort: 9 women who had previously experienced childbirth as traumatic
finding: Women who have previously experienced a traumatic birth have a strong desire to avoid a repeat experience and to feel in control of their birth choices in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women considered a range of birth choices, from elective cesareans to freebirth, to avoid a repeat traumatic experience and maintain control.
